skill.summary: CLI tool to manage Facebook Pages: list, create, read, hide, delete posts; list, create, delete comments; and get page info via the Graph API.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Added allowlist.json and exec-approvals.json for managing permissions and command approvals.
- Removed .clawhub/origin.json.
- Updated cron job instructions to use US/Eastern timezone instead of Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh.
- Added section on setup.ps1 for making the CLI executable on Windows.
- Documented error handling and how to resolve missing dependency issues (e.g., "Cannot find module 'commander'").
- Expanded references to configuration and permission control files.
